title: Vendors
controls: View (text-link-sm row action, one per vendor row — five in total)
table_headers: Vendor | Category | Contact | Paid YTD | Status | (empty)
structure:
The .content block holds exactly two children, in order.

1) .subnav — four .subnav-item divs: "Chart of accounts", "Vendors" (.active), "Bills & payments", "Bank reconciliation".

2) table.data-table, full width, immediately after the subnav (there is NO kpi-row on this screen). thead > tr with six th: "Vendor", "Category", "Contact", "Paid YTD", "Status", and a sixth empty th reserved for the row action.

tbody has five rows, no group-head rows. Every row's first td contains div.res-cell > div.res-avatar (two-letter initials, 32x32 navy-100 rounded square) + a wrapper div holding div.res-name (vendor name, bold 12.5px) and div.res-sub (grey 10.5px subtitle). The fourth td carries class num-cell (right aligned bold). The fifth td holds div.status-badge.active. The sixth td holds div.text-link-sm reading "View" (amber).

Rows top to bottom:
1. avatar "IE" / res-name "Island Electric Services" / res-sub "Electrical contractor"; Category "Maintenance"; Contact "Owen Grant · (876) 555 0110"; Paid YTD $142,300; badge "Active"; link "View".
2. avatar "AT" / "AquaTech Pool Services" / "Pool & water systems"; "Maintenance"; "(876) 555 0223"; $88,000; "Active"; "View".
3. avatar "FF" / "FitFix Equipment Repair" / "Gym & fitness equipment"; "Maintenance"; "(876) 555 0341"; $26,500; "Active"; "View".
4. avatar "G2" / "Gate2 Contractor Ltd" / "Barrier & access systems"; "Maintenance"; "(876) 555 0459"; $61,200; "Active"; "View".
5. avatar "JU" / "Jamaica Public Service Co." / "Utilities"; "Utilities"; "customercare@jpsco.com"; $94,300; "Active"; "View".
Only row 1 carries a named contact person before the phone number (middot separated); rows 2-4 show a bare phone number and row 5 shows an email address in the same cell. No footer, pagination, filters or search box is drawn.
domain_needs: vendor.name (e.g. "Jamaica Public Service Co." — trailing period is part of the name)
vendor.trade_description / subtitle (res-sub: "Electrical contractor", "Pool & water systems", "Gym & fitness equipment", "Barrier & access systems", "Utilities")
vendor.initials (res-avatar: IE, AT, FF, G2, JU — note "G2" and "JU" are not simple first-two-word initials, so store the avatar string rather than deriving it)
vendor.contact_phone (format "(876) 555 0110" — Jamaican format, spaces not dashes)
contact cell rendering rule: contact_person + " · " + phone when a person exists, otherwise phone alone, otherwise email alone (middot separator with spaces)
vendor.paid_ytd (derived: sum of payments to this vendor in the current year; displayed "$" + comma thousands, no decimals). Row sum = $412,300, not displayed anywhere
vendor.status (enum: Active — status-badge.active green; the stylesheet also defines paid/unpaid/overdue/matched/unmatched variants)
vendor.sort_order (drawn order is Island Electric, AquaTech, FitFix, Gate2, JPS — not alphabetical, not by amount; store an explicit order or sort key)
vendor → work order link: these are the vendors Facilities' work orders reference (Island Electric, AquaTech, FitFix, Gate2 all appear as bill vendors tied to tickets on screen 27)
vendor → expense account link implied (Maintenance vendors post to 5100 Maintenance & Repairs, Utilities vendors to 5200 Utilities — Common Areas)
row action route: "View" → vendor detail page
accounting_notes: No account codes, debits or credits are drawn on this screen, but the Paid YTD column is an accounting-derived figure and must tie to the ledger: Island Electric Services $142,300, AquaTech Pool Services $88,000, FitFix Equipment Repair $26,500, Gate2 Contractor Ltd $61,200, Jamaica Public Service Co. $94,300. These sum to $412,300 (not displayed). Paid YTD is the year-to-date total of payments cleared against that vendor's bills, i.e. the debit side of Dr 2000 Accounts Payable / Cr 1000 Operating Bank Account per payment; it must exclude bills still sitting unpaid in AP. Two ties to watch: Jamaica Public Service Co. Paid YTD $94,300 equals both the expense balance on account 5200 Utilities — Common Areas ($94,300, screen 25) and the still-unpaid JPS bill of $94,300 (screen 27), which is contradictory if read strictly — Paid YTD should not include an unpaid bill, so treat the JPS $94,300 as an accrued-but-unpaid amount and the equal Paid YTD figure as board data to reproduce verbatim rather than to recompute. Island Electric's Paid YTD $142,300 sits above the $9,650 "EFT — ISLAND ELECTRIC SVC" bank line on screen 28 (a prior invoice), consistent with cumulative YTD payments. Vendor category drives the default expense account for a bill (Maintenance → 5100, Utilities → 5200).
